about.en: MSFTon is the Ondo tokenized stock for Microsoft Corporation (MSFT), issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by MSFT shares and is a total-return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share and its price can drift above the underlying's. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xB812837b81a3a6b81d7CD74CfB19A7f2784555E5, with deployments on BNB Chain, Solana and HyperEVM.
